2608.29965.title: Review Before Trust: Source-Grounded Integrity Gates for AI-Assisted Personal Health Records
2608.29965.paper_summary: Large language models can convert medical documents into structured data, but plausible output may still be unsupported by the source. Persisting such output in a longitudinal health record, a record that accumulates patient information over time, therefore creates an integrity risk: unverified data may influence later summaries, trends, or preventive-care computations. We introduce an evidence-gated trust-promotion model that keeps generated data provisional until a deterministic monitor verifies it against the source document. The monitor admits a candidate for a specified downstream use only when the source contains a unique supporting quotation, the relevant fields occur within the same laboratory row, and the required provenance is preserved. The generator cannot approve its own output, missing or ambiguous evidence causes refusal, and refused candidates remain available for human review rather than being silently discarded. We implement the model in Medical DataCloud, a personal health-record application, and evaluate it through automated tests and a replay of saved extraction outputs. All 22 conformance and mutation tests pass. The replay covers nine historical laboratory PDF reports containing 102 manually labelled rows. The reports produce 97 numeric candidates: schema validation accepts all 97, an earlier packet-level evidence check accepts 94, and the hardened quotation- and row-level policy admits 72 while retaining 25 for review. The study evaluates system integrity rather than clinical correctness or clinical safety. The results demonstrate the technical feasibility of an enforceable boundary that prevents generated claims from authorizing their own reuse in a longitudinal health record.
2608.29965.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型可以將醫療文件轉換為結構化數據，但合理的輸出仍可能不受來源支持。因此，將這種輸出持續保留在縱向健康記錄中，即隨著時間累積患者信息的記錄，會產生完整性風險：未經驗證的數據可能影響後續的摘要、趨勢或預防護理計算。我們引入了一種證據門控的信任促進模型，該模型在確定性監控器驗證其與來源文件的對應關係之前，將生成的數據保持為臨時性。監控器僅在來源包含唯一支持引用、相關字段出現在同一實驗室行中，並且所需的來源保持不變時，才會接受候選項用於特定的下游用途。生成器不能批准自己的輸出，缺失或模糊的證據會導致拒絕，而被拒絕的候選項仍可供人類審查，而不是被靜默丟棄。我們在Medical DataCloud這個個人健康記錄應用中實施了該模型，並通過自動化測試和重播保存的提取輸出進行評估。所有22項符合性和變異測試均通過。重播涵蓋了九份包含102個手動標記行的歷史實驗室PDF報告。這些報告產生了97個數字候選項：模式驗證接受所有97個，早期的數據包級證據檢查接受94個，而加強的引用和行級政策接受72個，同時保留25個供審查。該研究評估系統的完整性，而非臨床正確性或臨床安全性。結果展示了一個可執行邊界的技術可行性，該邊界防止生成的聲明授權其在縱向健康記錄中的自我重用。
2608.29965.author: Nora Girda et.al.
